newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokai Kogyo says may take more restructuring steps.
newsitem.headline: Tokai Kogyo says may take more restructuring steps.

text.p: Construction company Tokai Kogyo Co Ltd said on Friday that it may take additional restructuring steps as its current restructuring programme has not been implemented smoothly.
"Implementation (of the restructuring plan) has not been smooth," a senior company official told a news conference.
The additional steps may include streamlining of branch offices, he added.
Tokai Kogyo, hurt by the bursting of Japan's "economic bubble" of inflated asset prices, is currently implementing a restructuring programme that covers the five years to October 1998.

Earlier on Friday Tokai announced a parent current loss of 1.10 billion yen in the six months to April 30 against a current profit of 1.89 billion yen in the same period a year ago. It also said that it expected to post a parent current profit of 200 million yen for the year to October 31, against an actual parent current profit of 1.67 billion yen a year ago.
